questions.question: In a certain code language, 'PRUNE' is written as '74'. How will 'LONDON' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc354e6db3efa2f122793f4f438c46b21573b349226dbd8a6f06e215a8c49a3f.png] 

**Code : Sum of alphabet positional value of given word.**

'PRUNE' is written as '74'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e65daf5048f6244be3f405c3de13be20f0f3db4cfa363412d4c43a1b58a09758.png] 

⇒ 16 + 18 + 21 + 14 + 5 = 74

Similarly,

'LONDON' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7165c724046ee57c02ec4ad99347f8d7882f6bdb6911460b9dedbfb916c66b37.png] 

⇒ 12 + 15 + 14 + 4 + 15 + 14 = 74

Hence, the correct answer is **"74".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

8 × 9 ÷ 15 + 30 - 5 = 63
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5d042a9aa7b95b83689de995a63e72369aef3f7bb21020a74fd1cd0663cda0a.png] 

Option 1) : - and × 

Given equation is : 8 × 9 ÷ 15 + 30 - 5 = 63

After interchanging signs in the given the equation formed is as follows : 

⇒ 8 - **__9 ÷ 15__** + 30 × 5 = 63

⇒ 8 - 0.6 + **__30 × 5__** = 63

⇒ **8 **- 0.6 **+ 150 **= 63

⇒ __**15**____**8 - 0.6**__ = 63

⇒ 157.4 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : + and -

Given equation is : 8 × 9 ÷ 15 + 30 - 5 = 63

After interchanging signs in the given the equation formed is as follows : 

⇒ 8 × __**9 ÷ 15**__ - 30 + 5 = 63

⇒ __**8 × 0.6**__ - 30 + 5 = 63

⇒ __**4.8**__ - 30 __**+ 5**__ = 63

⇒ **__9__****__.8 - 30__** = 63

⇒ 20.2 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : + and × 

Given equation is : 8 × 9 ÷ 15 + 30 - 5 = 63

After interchanging signs in the given the equation formed is as follows : 

⇒ 8 + **__9 ÷ 15__** × 30 - 5 = 63

⇒ 8 + **__0.6 × 30__** - 5 = 63

⇒ **__8 + 18__** - 5 = 63

⇒ __**26 - 5**__ = 63

⇒ 21 ≠ 63

LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 4) : ÷ and -**

**Given equation is : 8 × 9 ÷ 15 + 30 - 5 = 63**

**After interchanging signs in the given the equation formed is as follows : **

**⇒ 8 × 9 - 15 + __30 ÷ 5__ = 63**

**⇒ __8 × 9__ - 15 + 6 = 63**

**⇒ __72__ - 15 __+ 6__ = 63**

**⇒ __78 - 15__ = 63**

**⇒ 63 = 63**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and -".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

14 × 7 - 25 ÷ 5 + 95 = 104
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/097ebebed81f8c1fefff4ad7af31469cc22cd21e7dd16f8c481e1fad949052b9.png] 

Option 1) : 14 and 95

Given equation is : 14 × 7 - 25 ÷ 5 + 95 = 104 

After interchanging numbers in given equation the equation is as follows : 

⇒ 95 × 7 -** __25 ÷ 5__** + 14 = 104

⇒ __**95 × 7**__ - 5 + 14 = 104

⇒ **__665__** - 5 __**+ 14**__ = 104

⇒ __**679 - 5**__ = 104

⇒ 674 ≠ 104

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 25 and 7

Given equation is : 14 × 7 - 25 ÷ 5 + 95 = 104 

After interchanging numbers in given equation the equation is as follows : 

⇒ 14 × 25 - __**7 ÷ 5**__ + 95 = 104

⇒ 14 × __**25 - 1.4**__ + 95 = 104

⇒ **__350__** - 1.4 __**+ 95**__ = 104

⇒ **__445 - 1.4__** = 104

⇒ 443.6 ≠ 104

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 7 and 5

Given equation is : 14 × 7 - 25 ÷ 5 + 95 = 104 

After interchanging numbers in given equation the equation is as follows : 

⇒ 14 × 5 - **__25 ÷ 7__** + 95 = 104

⇒ **__14 × 5__** - 3.5714 + 95 = 104

⇒ **__70__** - 3.5714 **__+ 95__** = 104

⇒ **__165 - 3.5714__** = 104

⇒ 161.4286 ≠ 104

LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 4) : 25 and 95**

**Given equation is : 14 × 7 - 25 ÷ 5 + 95 = 104 **

**After interchanging numbers in given equation the equation is as follows : **

**⇒ 14 × 7 - __95 ÷ 5__ + 25 = 104**

**⇒ __14 × 7__ - 19 + 25 = 104**

**⇒ __98__ - 19 __+ 25__ = 104**

**⇒ __123 - 19__ = 104**

**⇒ 104 = 104**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"25 and 95".**

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All jewels are metals

No metal is a diamond.

Conclusions:

I. No jewel is a diamond.

II. No diamond is a metal.

III. Some metals are jewels.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30685a36cc1924c66c10c232ae7a334667d748cc8c1af02659ff016dc94b6810.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No jewel is a diamond → True (As All jewels are metals and No metal is a diamond so, No jewel is a diamond is true)

II. No diamond is a metal → True (As All jewels are metals and No metal is a diamond so, No diamond is a metal is true)

III. Some metals are jewels → True (As All jewels are metals so, Some metals are jewels is true)

∴ Here, All conclusions are true.

Hence, the correct answer is "All of the conclusions follow".
